title: PANs not permitted to trade for KYC (NSE ENIT NPTT file)
purpose: The cycle's NPTT file on NSE's member portal: PANs flagged KYC non-compliant (demise included) by the KRAs' data, which cannot trade or square off from the cycle's date until the KRA marks them compliant (reinstated T+1). None of the exchanges' or the depository's circulars gives the file's columns: they are read by their header names, which this layout lists (add a header text here when the file's differs). The file is matched by PAN, then the client code.
linked: Matched with the clients on Compliance → KYC trading gate: each client on it is held back on the front ends until the KRA verifies the KYC and a later list no longer has the client.
source: NSE/ISC/77375 (circular 50/2026), final para. The columns are not published: read by header names.
